summary: Preserve hand-added Slack endpoints missing from the archived OpenAPI spec (search.files, search.all, auth.teams.list, team.preferences.list, team.billing.info, bookmarks CRUD) and the opt-in xoxc+cookie web-client surface (client.counts, saved.list, drafts.list, activity.feed, subscriptions.thread.getView).
reason: The archived slackapi spec omits channel bookmarks, file/combined search, workspace team/preference/billing endpoints, and Slack's desktop/web client RPC endpoints (which require xoxc + d session cookie rather than OAuth xoxb-/xoxp- tokens). Without this customization a regen drops both the standard missing endpoints and the agentcookie-backed internal web-client commands.
validated_outcome: Live read-only verification confirmed ok:true on auth.teams.list, search.files, and search.all against SLACK_USER_TOKEN; offline httptest tests verify all OAuth, bookmarks CRUD, and xoxc+cookie web-client endpoints, ok:false detection, dry-run, and exit-code-4 auth handling.
